The temple’s day, in order

Opens 4:30 AM. Closes 1:00 PM for rest and re-opens at 4:15 PM until 9:00 PM. Turn on an alarm for any aarti.

    Questions

    Need help with timings or sponsorships?

    Call +91 92095 51462
    Is the app free?

    Yes. Schedule, Bhakti Tube, prayers, Ekadashi planner, stickers and ringtones are all free.

    Which languages does it support?

    English, Hindi and Marathi. Prayers show in both Roman and Devanagari.

    What works without internet?

    The Ekadashi calendar (2024–2028), saved reading pages, downloaded PDF books, ringtones and wallpapers.

    How do I donate for seva?

    Open Donate & Serve in the app and pay directly, or call Digvijay Arjundas (+91 99789 84699) or Ashray Giriraj Prabhu (+91 99227 63603).

    Where is the temple?

    Kanyadan Mangal Karyalaya, Bhosale Nagar, Hadapsar, Pune 411028. Open in Maps
